name: @obvia/collections
description: Immutable, fluent and deeply typed collections for TypeScript.

scripts.test:unit: bun run build && bun test tests/unit
scripts.test:behavior: bun run build && bun test tests/behavior
scripts.test:guards: bun run build && bun test tests/guards
scripts.test:properties: bun run build && bun test tests/properties
scripts.test:runtime: bun run build && bun test tests/unit tests/behavior tests/guards tests/properties

scripts.benchmark: bun run build && bun run benchmarks/collection.bench.ts
